title: Correct final force expression
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (1) must be equivalent to F = μmg / (sin θ - μ cos θ).

title: Correct final tangent
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (2) must be tan θ₀ = μ.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: The solution must correctly resolve the applied force and write vertical (N = F cos θ + mg) and horizontal (F sin θ = f) equilibrium equations.

title: Friction law application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the kinetic friction law f = μN when solving for constant speed in part (1).

title: Inequality derivation for motion
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must derive the condition for impossibility of motion (e.g., sin θ - μ cos θ ≤ 0) from the force equations and the requirement F → ∞.

title: Trigonometric manipulation
description: Optional: The solution may show clear steps in solving the simultaneous equations and manipulating the inequality to find tan θ₀.

title: Sign error in normal force
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly writes the vertical equilibrium as N + F cos θ = mg, missing that both forces push down.

title: Friction direction mistake
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student misidentifies the direction of the friction force relative to the applied horizontal component.

title: Confusing static/kinetic friction
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses static friction (or a wrong coefficient) for the constant-speed condition in part (1).
